title: rosa pendulina f. lagenaria
intro: Rosa pendulina f. lagenaria, commonly known as Lagenaria rose, is a plant species within the Rosa genus, known for its fragrant flowers and edible fruits. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa pendulina f. lagenaria include its sedative effects, which can aid in relaxation and reduce anxiety, as well as its anti-diabetic properties, which may help regulate blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of Rosa pendulina f. lagenaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
